network_enforcement: The exact Lean replay is delegated to check_validation.sh, which runs discovery and every Lean subprocess under bubblewrap with an unshared network, read-only host root, fixed environment, and one fresh temporary directory as its only writable bind. The outer Python reconciler performs local file, hash, process, and Git checks only.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line reconciliation summary bound in release-receipt.json

scope_boundary: This bounded worker recipe authenticates current inputs, replays the exact statement, frozen composition, three equation packages, and exact root at trust zero with network denied, and checks a negative release decision. It reuses pinned warm artifacts and cannot accept the validation dependency, reconcile the authoritative graph, supply H0/R0 or complete trust/provenance evidence, perform a cold offline release build, act as an independent verifier, or grant release/master acceptance.
